create EXTERNAL TABLE silver.Silvertable
(
    OrderID VARCHAR(50),
    OrderDate DATETIME2,
    CustomerID VARCHAR(50),
    CustomerName VARCHAR(50),
    CustomerEmail VARCHAR(70),
    ProductID VARCHAR(50) ,
    ProductName VARCHAR(50) ,
    ProductCategory VARCHAR(50) ,
    RegionID VARCHAR(50) ,
    RegionName VARCHAR(50) ,
    Country VARCHAR(50) ,
    Quantity VARCHAR(50) ,
    UnitPrice INT ,
    TotalAmount INT,
    Domain VARCHAR(50) 
)
